prompts: Original Japanese top-down pixel RPG asset visually inspired by Pokemon FireRed's overworld. Orthographic three-quarter TOP-DOWN RPG angle, front facing directly down to player, no isometric diamond or perspective convergence. Chunky deliberate pixels, crisp edges, restrained 24-color palette, dark colored outlines, sun from upper left, simple 3-shade clusters. Transparent background, no floor, no shadow beyond footprint, no text or logos. Readable when scaled down into a 16px-grid game. Match the attached reference sprites exactly in palette, outline and pixel density. pixel-art game sprite of the real storefront; not resembling any Nintendo / Game Freak / Pokémon asset. Explicit exception to prefix: real LAWSON signage REQUIRED. Use attached sprites visible in conversation as style reference only. Match the palette, outline weight, pixel density and three-quarter top-down angle of the attached reference sprites exactly. ONE isolated low Japanese Lawson convenience store. Broad BLUE sign fascia with WHITE milk-can LAWSON logo at left and big clear white LAWSON letters across center. Glass front, central double sliding door, cream walls, broad flat roof visible from above. No people or exterior shadow or ground. Draw on a 112x80 logical pixel grid enlarged to at least 1024px wide. Building fills canvas with 2 logical pixels margin, no cropping. Logo and LAWSON must survive downscale. Warm simple 3 shade clusters, crisp chunky 1-logical-pixel outlines.
notes: Real brand storefront by art-direction decision (#85); not affiliated. Anchors are zero-based runtime pixel coordinates from top-left. Door marks the threshold; foot marks the bottom-centre sorting point. collisionTiles is the 16px-grid ground footprint of the facade (roof overhang and transparent padding are not collision). Atlas is the artist-finished exact-size sprite: alpha>=128 crop, nearest-neighbour fit, quantized to <=31 colours + transparent, hard alpha. Map owner places a walkable portal in front of the door. Art reviewed at 1x and 3x/6x. The generated sprite showed the "S" of LAWSON as a G/6-like glyph; those 4x6 pixels were redrawn in Pillow with a plain S in the sign white/blue. Everything else is generated.
